measurement_notes: Time passes separate from preload count passes.
Timed comparison has 3 runs per case; latency statistics are medians of per-run quantiles, not pooled extreme-tail guarantees.
Each run has 100 isolated plus 100 distributed metadata mutations, identical raw final payload hashes.
Close/checkpoint, verification and compaction included in complete time; source preparation excluded.
Cold means OS page-cache residency checked with mincore after per-file fadvise, not device/controller cache cold.
Remote initial extra-codec profile passes overlapped a 3 s correctness test; excluded from architectural/profile ranking in favor of separate xeon-profiles-final campaign.
/proc write_bytes and preload write calls are process/filesystem observations, not physical HDD/RAID bytes.
